$comment: Pre-rendered provisioning payloads for Scout (Flow 0), consumed by scout_flow0_build.md. Each list has: createListBody (POST _api/web/lists), titleMerge (MERGE the Title field -> display name), fields[] (ordered SchemaXml strings for POST .../fields/createfieldasxml), and views[] (POST .../views). Fields are IN CREATE ORDER — run the Apply-to-each with concurrency=1 so calculated fields land after their inputs. All SchemaXml controls the internal Name so downstream flows (Tempo/Watchdog/Sweep/Sorter) reference stable names. Send bodies UTF-8; the en-dash (–) in category names is intentional Unicode.
